name: Xiao Li
title: Indomitable Martial Warrior
description: Then Xiao Li heard a rumor that Lü Bu had died in the Land of Peace. Unable to believe it, she set out to discover the truth—and astonishingly, swam across the sea to reach the Land of Peace. She then traveled from place to place asking after Lü Bu's whereabouts, until at last she found her grave.

localization.name: Opening Smash
localization.description:
400% damage to 1 enemy, plus 200% for each time this skill has already been used while on the battlefield (max of 1000% total damage after this skill has already been used 3 or more times).

Then the target hit has all Stealth status effects removed (including Super Stealth).

The user is granted a Charge. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store up to 3 charges and all charges are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield.

localization.name: Knockout Blaster
localization.description:
500% damage to 2 enemies, plus 100% for each time this skill has already been used while on the battlefield (max of 1000% total damage after this skill has already been used 5 or more times). The user is granted a Charge.

Then all targets hit have their Sleep Wards removed, burn removed (including Mega Healing Burn) and are granted Deep Sleep for 100TU. Deep Sleep will overwrite other status effects, cannot be overwritten by Burn or Sleep status effects, and cannot be Purified.

Usable only if the user has stored exactly one charge.
localization.selected:
500% damage, removes Sleep Wards & Burn
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Unleash Potential
localization.description:
Allies gain 8 Spirit.

Heals the user fully. The user is granted a Charge, Stun Ward, Instant Death Ward and Intense Rage. Usable only if the user has stored exactly two charges.

A Stun Ward prevents Stun from being applied once, then is removed. Stun Wards cannot stack. An Instant Death Ward prevents this unit from being immediately defeated without damage by a non-boss enemy once, then is removed. Instant Death Wards cannot be ignored and cannot stack. Intense Rage increases a unit's Attack to 1.5x for their next 3 turns, and will overwrite existing Weak or Enrage effects. It cannot be overwritten by other Enrage effects but can be by Weak effects.
localization.selected: User Gains Charge, Wards & Intense Rage

localization.name: Dragon Finisher
localization.description:
1000% damage to 1 enemy. If damage from this attack defeats an enemy, all other enemies on the battlefield will be Weakened and granted Deep Sleep for 100TU.

Usable only if the user has stored 3 Charges. Consumes all Charges on the user.

Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects.
localization.selected:
1000% damage, may Weaken & Sleep
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Combo Artist
localization.description:
This unit will immediately get the next turn after using Opening Smash, Knockout Blaster or Dragon Finisher. Then this effect cannot trigger again until 50TU advances.

Whenever this unit gets the turn, if this unit's Active Skills are not disabled, this unit can't have its Active Skills disabled until the end of its turn.

When this unit enters the battlefield, for 100TU this unit:
- Cannot fall asleep.
- Cannot be Frostburned.
- Has 80% damage reduction from attacks.

This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield, and cannot be defeated by damage from Poison or Burn status effects.

This unit's attacks will not wake sleeping enemies, heal this unit for 100% of total damage dealt, and ignore:
- damage reduction effects.
- any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent targets from being defeated.
- skin passive skills, and the Counter Stance status effect.

localization.name: Indomitable Warrior
localization.description:
This unit enters battle with a Stun Ward, and an Instant Death Ward.

If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

This unit will ignore attacks that would damage exactly 2 targets (attacks that target All allies will not be ignored). If this unit gains the Stealth status effect, it will not be lost when ignoring attacks in this way.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will heal for 50% of its max HP.

At the end of each sleeping enemy turn, this unit will be healed for 100% of its max HP, and have its current TU reduced by 50TU. This TU reduction may trigger before or after other effects that adjust the turn order. If this triggers 5 times within 50TU, this effect cannot trigger again until 50TU advances.

localization.name: HP Up Lv3
localization.description: Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.

localization.name: Spear Hunter Lv3
localization.description: 10% bonus to attacks against units equipped with Spears.

localization.name: Greatsword Mastery
localization.description: Can use weapon skills of Greatswords in addition to their original preferred weapon type.
